workflow.title: Stage Production Overview
workflow.description: Summarizes script, assets, storyboard, shot, timbre, and delivery progress from real episode outputs.

data.empty: No data to show yet. Complete the upstream stages and this area will summarize it.

timeline.title: Timeline Shot Check
timeline.boardDescription: Check shot order, duration, references, image, and video status before export.

boardDescriptions.characters: Check character images, script references, shot bindings, and voice prerequisites.
boardDescriptions.items: Check item reference images, script references, and prop bindings in shots.
boardDescriptions.environments: Check environment images, script scenes, and location bindings in shots.

script.title: Script Parse Entry Check
script.description: Review the current episode source text, SRT, and production settings, then inspect parsed clips and assets.
script.noSource: No script text or SRT content yet.

scriptReview.title: Script Breakdown Review
scriptReview.description: Review AI-generated clips and check scene, character, prop, screenplay, and storyboard completeness.

timbre.title: Character Timbre Match Check
timbre.description: Check each character's voice binding, uploaded reference audio, script references, and shot references before delivery.

storyboard.title: Storyboard Group Check
storyboard.boardDescription: Check shot count, asset references, image generation, and video output by storyboard group.

panel.title: Shots Pending
panel.description: Groups below their planned shot count.

refs.title: Asset Refs Pending
refs.description: Character, scene, or prop references are incomplete.

image.title: Images Pending
image.description: Structured shots that still need storyboard images.

ready.title: Videos Ready
ready.description: All shots in the group have video outputs.

shot.title: Shot Production Queue
shot.description: Review image, video, asset references, and production readiness by shot, then open details for missing items.
shot.overviewDescription: Group shots by image, video, delivery, and attention states for faster production passes.

image.title: Image Pending
image.description: Shots without a first frame or storyboard image.

video.title: Video Pending
video.description: Shots with images but no video output yet.

delivery.title: Deliverable
delivery.description: Shots with both image and video ready.

shotDetail.boardDescription: Check image, video, asset references, prompts, duration, and failures before editing the shot.

export.title: Export Delivery Check
export.description: Check final video, asset package, delivery manifest, and audio materials before download.
export.useStageDownloads: Use the export stage cards below for downloads

workbench.title: Project Workbench Overview
workbench.description: Maps the FrameOS workbench root page and aggregates script, asset, storyboard, production, and delivery progress.

slots.primary: Review the current episode and stage status.
slots.secondary: Check missing scripts, assets, storyboards, or video outputs.
slots.handoff: Use the left workflow stages to continue production.

script.title: Script Parse
script.description: Maps the FrameOS /script page for material import, episode content editing, and script parsing.

slots.primary: Edit the current episode text and production basics.
slots.secondary: Confirm aspect ratio, visual style, and narration settings.
slots.handoff: Generate the script structure, then continue to asset setup.

script-review.title: Script Review
script-review.description: Maps workbench/script-review for reviewing AI-generated clips, characters, and locations.

slots.primary: Review short-drama clips, dialogue, and narration breakdown.
slots.secondary: Find story nodes that need rewrite or additional detail.
slots.handoff: Continue to character, item, and environment assets.

characters.title: Character Assets
characters.description: Maps workbench/assets/characters for character profiles, appearances, and references.

slots.primary: Maintain character cards, aliases, descriptions, and images.
slots.secondary: Check where each character is used in script clips.
slots.handoff: Continue to item, environment, or storyboard design.

items.title: Item Assets
items.description: Maps workbench/assets/items for props, key objects, and reusable item assets.

slots.primary: Organize key props and visual requirements.
slots.secondary: Check whether items are linked to relevant shots.
slots.handoff: Use confirmed items as storyboard and video references.

environments.title: Environment Assets
environments.description: Maps workbench/assets/environments for scenes, locations, and environment references.

slots.primary: Maintain locations, summaries, and scene reference images.
slots.secondary: Check scene coverage against script clips.
slots.handoff: Continue to storyboard design after environments are confirmed.

timbre.title: Character Timbre Match
timbre.description: Maps workbench/assets/timbre for character voices, narration, and dialogue timbre.

slots.primary: Generate or bind character voices and dialogue audio.
slots.secondary: Check voice coverage and missing lines.
slots.handoff: Continue to shot production or export once voices are ready.

storyboard.title: Storyboard Design
storyboard.description: Maps workbench/storyboard for generating, editing, and reviewing storyboard visuals.

slots.primary: Generate storyboard images and refine visual prompts.
slots.secondary: Check consistency with script clips and referenced assets.
slots.handoff: Continue to shot production after storyboard approval.

episodes.title: Production · Episodes
episodes.description: Maps workbench/production/episodes for episode-level production progress and missing items.

slots.primary: Switch episodes and inspect each production state.
slots.secondary: Check whether script, assets, storyboards, and videos are complete.
slots.handoff: Choose an episode, then enter timeline or shot production.

timeline.title: Timeline Production
timeline.description: Maps workbench/production/timeline for organizing generated videos in shot order.

slots.primary: Review video shots in storyboard order and missing states.
slots.secondary: Check duration, narration, and visual continuity.
slots.handoff: Continue to export delivery once the timeline is complete.

shot.title: Shot Production
shot.description: Maps workbench/production/shot for batch or single-shot video generation.

slots.primary: Generate single-shot videos, batch run, and retry failed shots.
slots.secondary: Check first/last frames, video prompts, and model settings.
slots.handoff: Continue to timeline or export after shots are complete.

shot-detail.title: Shot Detail
shot-detail.description: Maps workbench/production/shot/:shotId for a single shot's prompt, references, and generation output.

slots.primary: Inspect one shot's visual, prompt, and video output.
slots.secondary: Check referenced assets, first/last frames, and failure causes.
slots.handoff: Return to batch shot production after the shot is approved.

export.title: Export Delivery
export.description: Maps workbench/production/export for final video, asset package, and editing draft delivery.

slots.primary: Review final video, asset package, and editing draft exports.
slots.secondary: Confirm missing shots, storyboards, and materials are resolved.
slots.handoff: Generate final download records after delivery checks pass.

storyInput.videoRatioHint: Pick a ratio that matches your target platform and content format

ratioUsage.1_1: 1:1: Square frame, good for avatars, covers and generic social posts
ratioUsage.9_16: 9:16: Vertical video, ideal for TikTok, Reels, Shorts and other short‑video feeds
ratioUsage.16_9: 16:9: Horizontal video, ideal for YouTube, Bilibili and desktop playback
ratioUsage.4_3: 4:3: Classic TV ratio, useful for legacy footage or safe cropping
ratioUsage.3_4: 3:4: Slightly vertical, suitable for mixed text + video layouts
ratioUsage.2_3: 2:3: More vertical, good for posters and character key art
ratioUsage.3_2: 3:2: Slightly horizontal, good for landscapes and story scenes
ratioUsage.4_5: 4:5: Vertical poster ratio, common in social feed images
ratioUsage.5_4: 5:4: Horizontal poster ratio, suitable for PC web banners
ratioUsage.21_9: 21:9: Ultra‑wide cinematic frame, ideal for movie‑like shots and panoramas
